mechanism_narrative: The sharp drop in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals fewer commuting trips, which suppresses incidental retail visits and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC becomes higher over the next 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the snapshot levels, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and WORKPLACES stays depressed, households shift time away from out-of-home shopping, causing RETAIL_REC to fall further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 15% and WORKPLACES staying below -25%, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week collapse in TRANSIT below the current very low level indicates renewed access restrictions or commuting disruption, and that policy shock transmits into weaker retail footfall within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 10 points week-on-week from an already sub -60% level
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -67.0 in t-0w and has been below -60 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 7 days after a further TRANSIT drop from the current sub -60% range, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility shifts discretionary trips toward outdoor leisure and back into nearby retail corridors, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks if park mobility recovers from its latest trough.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -20% after a weekly trough below -30%
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -11.7 to -35.7 in the last two weeks
failure_condition: If PARKS recovers above -20% but RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent weakness in GROCERY_PHARM alongside higher RESIDENTIAL indicates home-centered substitution and fewer combined shopping trips, which drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays negative and RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The late-monsoon period reduces outdoor shopping and walk-in retail activity; when PARKS and TRANSIT both remain deeply negative, RETAIL_REC should stay below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while PARKS and TRANSIT remain suppressed, the seasonal mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops deteriorating and begins to recover from its current low base, commuting and lunch-hour retail traffic return with a lag and push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -25% after being below -30%
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -32.3 in t-0w after -33.0 in t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES improves above -25% and RETAIL_REC still falls over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of severe TRANSIT weakness and elevated RESIDENTIAL indicates people are staying close to home and avoiding discretionary trips, so retail-and-recreation mobility should decline further almost immediately.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -67.0 and RESIDENTIAL is 17.7 in t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not move lower within 7 days while TRANSIT stays below -65% and RESIDENTIAL stays above 15%, the hypothesis fails.
